title: The Difficult question in the exam
subtitle: 努力坚持 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）
meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：difficult　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 difficult 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the engineer wrote of ① a difficult question in the exam in the manual, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② more difficult than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the engineer, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the difficult ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most difficult question in the exam anybody in the workshop had ever seen, or so the manual for April 1968 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too difficult to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the difficult ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lever at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a difficult man on the committee, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as difficult as the man on the committee they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was difficult or not, and he said so.

By 1981 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the manual. What the line asked for was ⑦ something difficult, and nothing besides. The worker from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite difficult; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the manual kept the names of the difficult ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1984, for the whole place, she wrote of another difficult question in the exam in the same manual, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more difficult than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most difficult man on the committee in the whole workshop, she said in 1986, was the one she could never quite name; the difficult ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 困难（前置定语 a difficult question in the exam：1974 年工程师在说明书里记下的那件困难的难题）
B. adj. 困难／难相处（比较级 more difficult than：文中两处，一处比考卷上的难题，一处比预想）
C. adj. 困难／难相处（最高级 the most difficult：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 困难（表语 too difficult to do：母亲觉得它太困难，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 难相处（前置定语 a difficult man on the committee：叔叔把整件事称作一桩难相处的人）
F. adj. 难相处（同级比较 as difficult as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩委员会里难缠的人相比）
G. adj. 难相处（后置定语 something difficult：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 难相处（受程度副词修饰 quite difficult：那位工人的评价）

items.q: a difficult question in the exam
the most difficult question in the exam anybody
a difficult man on the committee
The most difficult man on the committee in

answers.why: difficult 意为“困难”，1974 年工程师在说明书里记下的是“一件困难的难题”，此处作前置定语 a difficult question in the exam。
difficult 意为“困难”，此处用比较级 more difficult than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
difficult 意为“困难”，说明书上 四月 那行字说它是车间里最困难的一件，故用最高级 the most difficult question in the exam。
difficult 意为“困难”，母亲认为这件东西“太困难了，谁也用不上”，too difficult to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
difficult 意为“难相处”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩难相处的人”，此处作前置定语 a difficult man on the committee。
difficult 意为“难相处”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩委员会里难缠的人一样难相处”，同级比较用 as difficult as。
difficult 意为“难相处”，说明书上那半行字要的是“难相处的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something difficult。
difficult 意为“难相处”，邻车间来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当难相处”，quite 修饰原级 difficult。
difficult 意为“难相处”，1984 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要难相处”，故用比较级 more difficult than。
difficult 意为“难相处”，母亲 1986 年说的是“整个车间里最难相处的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most difficult man on the committee。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年，工程师在说明书里记下了一件困难的难题。（a difficult question in the exam）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更困难。（more difficult than …）
母亲觉得它太困难，谁也用不上。（too difficult to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩难相处的人。（a difficult man on the committee）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩委员会里难缠的人一样难相处。（as difficult as …）
到了 1981 年，说明书上只剩半行字：要的是一件难相处的东西。（something difficult）
answers: In 1974 the engineer wrote of a difficult question in the exam in the manual.
Everybody said it was more difficult than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too difficult to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a difficult man on the committee.
He said nobody would call it as difficult as the man on the committee they had once had.
By 1981 the manual asked for nothing but something difficult.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 difficult 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1974 the engineer wrote of a difficult question in the exam in the manual, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most difficult question in the exam in the workshop, or so the manual says.
My mother thought it too difficult to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a difficult man on the committee, and nobody argued with him.
The worker from the next workshop called the plan quite difficult, and everybody laughed.
The difficult ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
